verdict.rationale: Decagon documents that its integrations let the agent "retrieve data, take action" across channels. Its security page describes short-lived JWT tokens "scoped for minimal privilege and discarded after each session". Refund logic is referenced as something teams adjust, but scoping is described per session rather than per action, and there are no developer-facing docs on wiring custom APIs. The OpenAPI probe found no public spec. missing for 10: documented per-action auth scoping, explicit developer docs for connecting custom APIs to actions like refunds, order changes and subscription updates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the agent takes real actions through my APIs — refunds, order changes, subscription updates — with scoped auth per action

citations.quote: They ensure your agent can retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels with no custom code required.
Short-lived JWT tokens give AI agents real-time access to customer systems, scoped for minimal privilege and discarded after each session.
